methodology: Form 4 insider transactions (SEC EDGAR EFTS, filed-date PIT, public domain). Non-derivative pure buy (A) / sell (D) only — exercises and options excluded. Window spans 2016→today (Trump Era). Recent rows link the EDGAR filing-index page (built from the row's accession + reporting-owner CIK — empty, never guessed, on pre-accession aggregates). Display-only, exploratory, not a research claim. Universe narrowed from 30 to 1 issuers from 2016 (pre-2016 yearly aggregates retained verbatim from the wider universe).
